The production nightclub phase writes q004_judy_met positively after the Judy introduction. The exact Information quest journal must be completed. Judy is a scene actor and participant; private Evelyn/Dex negotiation is excluded.

The q004_nightclub phase runs q004_02_meeting_evelyn (Evelyn is actor 0 and speaks 98 of the scene lines alongside the player) and then q004_03_this_is_judy (Evelyn is actor 0, Judy actor 1, the player present): in The Information V meets Evelyn in person and she is with V at Judy's workshop. The rule also requires the completed Information journal state.

The optional scan-security objective has its own Succeeded input from scene node3541. It must be revealed as Succeeded, with BD completion and exact Information quest completion. Judy needs a disclosure receipt because she is absent from the suite-recording scene actors.

Lab choices 442/862 option 0 reject the ICEbreaker and converge on exact q304_songbirds_path=1 at scene node 81. The q304 deal phase reaches lab_done only after the Songbird wake continuation returns. Parent main graph routes this positive branch to q306. This establishes save-recorded history, including initialized history, not who physically selected a button.

Lab choices 442/862 option 1 use the ICEbreaker. q304 deal phase enters gender-specific ReplacerSwitchEndMaleReed/FemaleReed entries; scene starts 1832/1837 write q304_alex_dead=1 at 2653/4900. V accuses Songbird after Alex is killed; Reed confirms the ICEbreaker over comms. q304_lab_done is written on the completed Reed exit. Alex death is not inferred from songbirds_path=0.

rules.statement: In the gig Hippocratic Oath V found her in the Clean Cut clinic, where Maelstrom was holding her, and escorted her out to the fixer's transport. This does not establish whether V helped her finish treating the wounded Maelstromer.

In the gig Concrete Cage Trap V found him hiding in a Kabuki housing block with Militech closing in and escorted him out to the ride Regina Jones had arranged. This does not establish what he took, or that he stayed safe afterwards.

In the gig Freedom of the Press V came to his booby-trapped studio for Regina Jones and brought him out of it alive to Regina's people. This does not establish how he agreed to leave or what he thinks of V.

In The Information V came into Lizzie's Bar to meet Evelyn Parker and the bartender Mateo greeted V by name and told V to look around the club. This does not say what V and Evelyn discussed or did afterwards.

In this save V sided with Songbird in the stadium lab operation. When the escape broke out, the BARGHEST alarm under Murphy's (Kruger's) voice went through the stadium telling the soldiers to stop the intruders and not let them escape, naming Songbird, a heavily chipped Asian woman, as the main target. This says nothing about whether he lived.

At the roulette table at the Black Sapphire, Aymeric and his twin sister Aurore played on one colour with everything at stake against V on the other, and V won the all-in exchange when the Cassels lost their stake. This does not claim V won every earlier spin.
